svg.title: Gateway Aggregation
svg.desc: Gateway Aggregation. Fan one client request out to several services and merge the answers into one response. Step 1, A chatty client: The app calls 3 services one after another over a slow network: 3 round trips, about 600 ms. Step 2, One request, fanned out: One request: the gateway calls all 3 services in parallel and merges the answers, about 235 ms. Step 3, Partial failure: Reviews times out after 100 ms: the page still arrives, without reviews. Product is required. Step 4, Know the limits: Keep business logic out, scale and watch it, mind dependent calls, cache what rarely changes.

g.text: The app calls 3 services one after another over a slow network: 3 round trips, about 600 ms.
One request: the gateway calls all 3 services in parallel and merges the answers, about 235 ms.
Reviews times out after 100 ms: the page still arrives, without reviews. Product is required.
Keep business logic out, scale and watch it, mind dependent calls, cache what rarely changes.
